source: Permissible short-term strain for a single (or infrequent) snap assembly and flexural modulus, after the Bayer/Covestro design guide 'Snap-Fit Joints for Plastics' (unreinforced grades). FDM-printed values are much lower than molded and depend on layer orientation (beam axis should lie in the XY plane).
